The only loose end is the unidentified Duchess in the background."},"emotion":{"score":4,"reason":"The unprovoked crop strike and degrading orders create immediate anger and sympathy for Juliana; the concealed medical items give a small, satisfying spark of hidden strength."},"want_next":{"score":3,"reason":"The secret antidote makes me curious whether Juliana will outsmart her tormentor, but the long cleaning sequence dulls the urgency before the final tease."},"ad_policy":{"level":"mild","category":"violence","reason":"A riding crop is used to strike Juliana across the torso and is thrust threateningly into Prudence's face; on-screen physical violence without visible blood."},"one_line_verdict":"A brutally effective cold open undercut by a soft, talky ending."}],"best":"C1","best_why":"It is the sole candidate, and its first three seconds deliver a rare, context-free act of cruelty that instantly establishes stakes."}
